---
title: "Overview of Ecosystem Service: Physical Health (Hypertension)"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    standalone: true
---

Urban greenspace is valued as the hypertension treatment cost it avoids. Greener urban
surroundings lower the odds of hypertension, so each city's greenness translates into avoided
cases among its adults, priced at the country's published cost of treating one case. The base
year is 2019.

⚠ Coverage is limited to the countries with a refereed treatment-cost study (20, appendix
Table A1), by construction; every other country carries NA with the absence named. The
counterfactual is a zero-vegetation city, which does much of the work in the magnitude.

## Quantity

Per urban pixel on WorldPop's 1 km grid: population times annual NDVI (clamped at zero below),
summed per country over pixels inside the urban settlement mask
(`health_hypertension_urban_smod_min`). That sum, in 0.1-NDVI increments, times the WHO
hypertension prevalence among adults 30-79, times one minus the risk ratio, times the 30-79
population share, is the country's avoided cases. The risk ratio comes from the meta-analytic
odds ratio (`health_hypertension_odds_ratio`) converted at the country's own prevalence as the
baseline (Grant 2014).

## Price

The country's per-person hypertension treatment cost in 2019 USD, one refereed study per
country (appendix Table A1), read from the staged table.

## Valuation

$$
\text{GEP}_i = c_i \; x_i \, \frac{\sum_{j \in \text{urban}} \text{NDVI}_j \, n_j}{0.1} \left(1 - \text{RR}_i\right) s_i
$$

with $c_i$ the treatment cost, $x_i$ the prevalence, $\text{RR}_i$ the converted risk ratio,
$s_i$ the 30-79 population share and $n_j$ the pixel population. The appendix's own Table 6 is
carried beside the result as the comparison anchor; because the authors' pixel-level choices
are not fully pinned, agreement is judged at the level-and-rank grade.

## Inputs

All paths and parameters come from `es_parameters.csv` under the `health_hypertension` service
key: the WorldPop mosaic, the annual NDVI, the GHS-SMOD urban mask and its threshold, the WHO
prevalence, the 30-79 shares, the cost table, the odds ratio and the appendix reference, each
with a source row beside it.
